resources.string: Swipe to rotate the sphere. Tap an icon to open an app.\n\nUse search to find an app quickly, or switch to the 2D grid. Tap the background to bring hidden controls back.
Sphere Launcher reads the installed-app list to display and open your apps locally. Camera and microphone access are optional, for features you enable separately.

Choose Sphere Launcher as your Home app to return to your sphere with the Home button or gesture.\n\nYou can switch back in Android Settings → Apps → Default apps → Home app. Menu names may vary by phone.
This is optional. You can try the sphere first and choose your Home app later in launcher settings.
Sphere Launcher is already your Home app.
